ClinicalConversation.title: ClinicalConversation
ClinicalConversation.description: Represents a transcribed clinical session encounter and its extracted entities.

title.description: The description or title of the encounter

createdAt.description: The timestamp of creation in ISO-8601 format

rawTranscript.description: The raw string of conversation transcript

hasAudio.description: Whether an audio recording is associated

status.description: Current status of the annotation workflow

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the owner

isShared.description: Whether this session is shared for cloning

sharedFromId.description: If cloned, the original session ID

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Represents custom AI settings (Bring Your Own Model) for speech transcription and clinical annotations.

transcription.description: Provider, model, API key, and base URL configuration for audio transcription and diarization

annotation.description: Provider, model, API key, and base URL configuration for clinical entity recognition

/clinical_conversations/{conversationId}.description: The main collection of clinical conversations and structured annotations.

/user_settings/{userId}.description: Custom model and credential configurations mapped per-user.
